# Hospitality App

> The all-in-one operations system for independent UK hospitality — pubs, inns, bars, restaurants, cafés, coffee shops, hotels and B&Bs. Tightly-scoped modules in one app: rota, till, room management, KDS, mobile ordering, reservations and floor plans, clock-in, payroll reports, tips & tronc, reporting, stock, compliance, team & HR, communication, the rota diary, and event tickets. Event tickets, online deposits and online ticket payments are not on the published plan prices. QR table ordering and menu boards are available on request and switched on per venue. Built for owner-operators, not enterprise chains. Room management is easy rooms for pubs with rooms, inns and small hotels, with bar and food on the guest's bill. It is not on the published plan prices: talk to us.

Hospitality App (also written HospitalityApp) is a UK SaaS product. The marketing site is hospitalityapp.co.uk; the product itself runs at my.hospitalityapp.co.uk (iOS, Android and web). Pricing is per venue, per month, +VAT, with a 30-day free trial on Complete Plus (no card required): Essentials £49 (10 active staff), Professional £99 (20), Complete £149 (30), Complete Plus £199 (50). Annual is twelve months paid up front: £490, £990, £1,490, £1,990. Essentials covers the rota, clock-in (time & attendance), leave, team communication and basic daily checklists. Professional adds the full compliance suite, advanced scheduling and payroll reports (including an all-branches payroll report). Complete adds the till (POS, with printed kitchen tickets), stock control, tips & tronc, the insights suite and white-label branding — there is no separate POS bolt-on. Complete Plus adds mobile ordering, kitchen display (KDS), table reservations and floor plans; none of these four is on Complete. Multi-branch (shared staff, cross-site rota with a double-booking guard, venue switcher) is included on every plan. There is no per-terminal or per-device fee, and no per-head fee inside your staff allowance; extra active staff above it are £3 per person per month. Annual billing takes two months off.

## The commercial argument

The joins between the modules are the product. Anyone can sell a rota.

- The **rota** knows what labour costs, because it holds everyone's hourly rate.
- The **till** knows what you took, so labour % is a live number, not a month-end guess.
- The **clock** knows who actually worked, so the payroll report is built from punches rather than memory.
- The **stock** knows what the till sold, so it depletes itself and GP is real.
- **Compliance** hangs off the same shift checklist staff already tick.

No competitor at this price point closes that loop for a single-site independent.

## Modules

- [Rota & scheduling](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/rota-management/): drag-drop builder, four views (role / staff / timeline / week), live labour-cost ticker, over-budget speed bump on publish, unpublish a week, shift templates with task lists, open shifts staff claim from the app.
- [Time & attendance](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/rota-management/): three clock-in methods (GPS geofence, QR code, NFC tag), combinable. Overnight-safe, auto-close sweep so a forgotten clock-out never becomes a 30-hour shift, discrepancies queue with one-tap resolutions.
- [Payroll & pay](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/payroll/): payroll reports built from actual clock punches, not memory — hours and pay for any date range, with a CSV export. Planned / exact / rounded basis, three views, verified-recipient email pack and an all-branches report. A rate change is dated, so earlier shifts keep the old rate. A bank-detail change alerts managers. Payroll reports are Professional and up. "My pay" for staff is on every plan. We produce payroll reports and a CSV export; we don't run payroll or file RTI.
- [Tips & tronc](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/guides/tronc-tips-act-2023): card tips pull from the till automatically; cash entered manually; Calculate → Review → Finalise produces the dated tronc statement the Employment (Allocation of Tips) Act 2023 requires.
- [Till / POS](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/till-pos/): full-screen, no chrome. Counter or table service, measure popup (half/pint, single/double, 175ml/250ml/bottle) with an optional mixer after the measure, tables + tabs, pay at table, PIN-attributed sales, cash-drawer opens logged. A manager can refund one item or the whole sale (cash, card or Apple Pay). A REFUND receipt prints and the reason is recorded. Split a bill by item. Options, extras and mixers sit on the line. A £ adjustment needs a reason. Staff drinks have their own button. Print the bill. Held sales stay with that PIN. Tips can be card or cash and can be split; a discount never changes the tip. Food can print in the kitchen and drinks at the bar, and a printer can be tested remotely. Start-of-day drawer count; end of day compares the drawer with the card-machine total and puts the difference on the Z, which can be reprinted. Venue colours, logos and a receipt logo. Allergen grid and a printable guest chart. Windows till: https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/till-windows Included in Complete (£149/venue/mo). Where room management is on, an open tab (taken at the bar, or at the table on a staff phone) can be charged to a room and lands on that stay's folio, settled at check-out. The till does not take the card.
- [Room management](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/rooms/): easy room management for pubs with rooms, inns and small hotels, in the same system as the till. The main point is that bar and food orders go straight onto the guest's room bill. Order at the bar on the till, or at the table on a staff phone. From that open tab, choose the room. It lands on the folio next to the room nights. The guest pays everything at check-out by card, cash or bank transfer, and an itemised VAT invoice is emailed. Room nights are at 20% VAT. Bar and food keep the VAT already on the till. Also included, kept plain: room types and rates (room only or B&B, with a minimum stay), a room-by-date diary with blocked dates, stays that cannot double-book, check-in and check-out with the UK guest register (Immigration (Hotel Records) Order 1972 fields), housekeeping status per room (clean, dirty, inspected, out of order), and occupancy, ADR and RevPAR alongside takings. An optional online room request page at `/book/<slug>/rooms` that a manager switches on. Guests send a request; the venue confirms the stay. Not on the published plan prices: talk to us. Not included: a channel manager or OTA connection (Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb), online card payments for rooms, door locks, or Xero. Do not describe any of those as available or as coming soon.
- [Mobile ordering](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/mobile-ordering/): staff take orders on their own phone in the staff app while clocked in. Tabs, discounts, remove a line, a bar ticket, print the bill, and Dojo Tap to Pay. Bookings can be taken on the phone. Included in Complete Plus. Do not describe a till list of open mobile orders as generally available. QR table ordering (guests order for themselves) and digital menu boards (TVs show the live menu; prices update from the till) are available on request and switched on per venue, and are not on a published plan.
- [Table reservations & floor plans](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/reservations-floor-plans/): guest page at my.hospitalityapp.co.uk/book/your-venue plus an embeddable widget. Rules cover table time by party size, last booking, after-midnight slots, a mandatory mobile number, and closed dates with time windows. Diary is Day, Week or Month, plus a block planner. On the till, Reservations can amend a booking, seat the party with a PIN, and show who is due back. Floor-plan editor: rooms, pan and zoom, print A4. Guest contact numbers are managers-only; Show number is audited. Phone bookings can be created and amended by staff with the Can take bookings permission. Optional Stripe deposit goes to the venue's own Connect account; Hospitality App takes no fee; the guest gets a deposit-paid email; taking the deposit off the bill shows as Deposits on the Z. Included in Complete Plus. Do not put the deposit on a different plan.
- [Kitchen display (KDS)](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/kitchen-display/): stations, colour, allergens and text size. Courses: hold the mains. The first course goes when the order is sent; later courses wait until the server or the pass calls them away. Printed kitchen tickets do not hold courses yet. Included in Complete Plus (Complete prints kitchen tickets instead).
- [Stock & GP](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/stock-control/): container-first stocktake — kegs and bottles counted with a stepper and 0 · ¼ · ½ · ¾ · Full chips. Never millilitres. Wet and dry counts are separate. Auto-depletion on every till sale. GP stops being a quarterly guess.
- [Reporting & insights](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/reporting/): Owner Today with a Flash P&L card (Sales, GP, Labour) on the first screen. Pay discrepancies show on the Today screen. Sales drill down from category to product, on a custom date range, with CSV export. Labour is planned against actual. Till Insights across five tabs — Busy periods (day×hour heatmap, sales vs staffing), Forecast, Labour, Profit (with a "costs missing" warning), 13-month Trends with same-season comparison. Venues with rooms also see occupancy, ADR and RevPAR alongside takings.
- [Compliance & tasks](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/compliance/): ten categories (Food safety, Fire safety, Alcohol licensing, Health & safety, Workforce, Background checks, Data protection, Environmental, Accessibility, Insurance) with photo evidence, numeric readings with min/max bands, expiring-certificate reminders, shift-attached tasks. Compliance that lives inside the work gets done.
- [Team & HR](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/solution/#people): the full record — hourly rate, NI, tax code, right-to-work (share code + verified-on date), DOB (drives NMW age bands), bank details for payroll, per-area permissions, multi-site with per-venue rates. Column-level privacy enforced in the database, not the UI.
- [Communication](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/team-communication/): noticeboard with read receipts, direct messages, contacts directory with an emergency-pin banner, push notifications with four opt-out categories honoured server-side, automatic shift reminders. Not the WhatsApp group.
- [Events & diary](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/team-communication/): private parties, functions, sports fixtures and holidays with covers, brief, task list and their own discussion thread — inline on the rota. This is not ticket sales.
- [Events & tickets](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/events-tickets/): free or paid tickets on the venue's own site. Payments go to the venue's own Stripe account. Hospitality App takes no commission; Stripe's own fees still apply. The venue can set a booking fee and its VAT. Each ticket has a unique QR, emailed to the guest. A phone door scanner checks it in and flags already-scanned, refunded, or wrong-event tickets. Live on-sale countdown and a website embed snippet. Refund selected tickets. Events can run past midnight. Food or drink included in the ticket is rung on the till at £0. Not on the published plan prices.
- [Online payments](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/about/): Stripe Connect. Payments for booking deposits and event tickets go to the venue's own Stripe account. Hospitality App takes no commission on deposits or tickets. The till itself does not take the card. Room requests still do not take a card payment.

## Where each surface runs

- **Web app** — `my.hospitalityapp.co.uk`. The full product. Desktop gets a sidebar layout, mobile web gets a tab bar — same screens.
- **Native app (iOS + Android)** — the staff and manager experience, with the things a browser can't do: GPS, NFC, camera, push, offline-ish speed.
- **Till** — `/till/run`, or a paired kiosk (single-use code, boots straight in, no login).
- **Windows till** — Hospitality App Till for Windows runs the same till (menu, tabs, table service, split bills, discounts, end of day / Z report) full screen on Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit): a touchscreen Windows EPOS terminal, an all-in-one POS PC or an ordinary Windows PC. Paired with a code from Settings → Devices (staff use their till PIN, no email logins); starts with Windows and stays on the till; prints receipts and opens the cash drawer through a receipt printer installed in Windows (e.g. a USB thermal ESC/POS printer) or a network receipt printer on the venue LAN (port 9100); waits and retries if the internet isn't there at start-up, reloads itself if it hangs, and updates itself when the till is idle. Installs without admin rights. Included in Complete, with no per-terminal fee. Download and setup steps: https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/till-windows
- **Kitchen display** — `/kitchen`, or a paired kiosk pinned to a station or the whole pass.
- **Mobile ordering** — staff order on their own phone in the staff app while clocked in, including bookings and Dojo Tap to Pay.

One codebase. The till, KDS and mobile-ordering runtimes are web code; a paired tablet runs them inside the native app's WebView, and Hospitality App Till for Windows runs the same till full screen on a Windows PC. This is why a menu change reaches the physical till without an app release — and why receipt printing over the venue's LAN (port 9100, ESC/POS) works from what is technically a web page.

## Free tools (no email required, no sign-up)

- [Rota template](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/tools/rota-template): free staff rota spreadsheet for UK hospitality. Overnight shifts calculate correctly (17:00–01:00 is 8 hours, not −16), live labour-cost % banded green/amber/red against your target, and two Working Time Regulations 1998 checks — a 20-minute break flag on shifts over 6 hours, and an 11-hour daily rest flag on the close-then-open. Works in Excel 2016+, Google Sheets, Numbers and LibreOffice.
- [Pub rota template](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/tools/pub-rota-template): same engine with cellar, glass collector and door in the role list.
- [Bar rota template](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/tools/bar-rota-template): cocktail bar, barback, glass collector and door, built for late trading.
- [Kitchen & front-of-house rota template](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/tools/kitchen-foh-rota-template): head chef to runner, both halves of the building costed on one sheet, split shifts handled.

## By venue type

- [Pubs](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/venues/pubs-and-bars/) — halves + pints, cellar checks, sports-event templates, tronc under the 2023 Act. Pubs with rooms can add easy room management, so bar and food go on the guest's bill (talk to us). Ticketed nights are [events and tickets](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/events-tickets/), not on the published plan prices.
- [Bars](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/venues/pubs-and-bars/) — spirits by the measure, cocktails, tronc, refusal log at the bar.
- [Restaurants](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/venues/restaurants/) — table service, KDS, allergen prompts, HACCP-ready compliance. A ticketed sitting is [events and tickets](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/features/events-tickets/), not on the published plan prices.
- [Cafés](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/venues/cafes/) — modifier chains, allergen matrix, honest GP on a short menu.
- [Coffee shops](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/venues/cafes/) — pre-work rush, mobile ordering, milk / syrup / bean stock.
- [Hotels](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/venues/hotels/) — multi-department rota, bar and food till, easy room management with bar and food on the guest's bill, function calendar, all-branches payroll report. Room management is talk to us, not a line on the plan prices.
- [B&Bs](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/venues/bnbs/) — right-sized for a small team, with easy room management (bar and food on the guest's bill), compliance and payroll reports. Room management is talk to us.

## Compare

- [Costing hub](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/compare/): which shape of system a UK pub needs — rota-only (priced per head), till-only (per venue or per terminal) or all-in-one (per venue) — with year-one costs worked from published vendor pricing for a 25-staff two-bar pub with one kitchen screen and £45,000/month card turnover. Key finding: the software spread across six priceable systems is £1,344/year, while the spread between a 1.75% and a 1.2% card rate on the same turnover is £2,970/year — so the payments decision is worth about 2.2x the software decision. Also carries the three sums to do for your own venue, and a full-disclosure section listing Hospitality App's own weaknesses, including that it has no integrated card payments.

- [Epos Now alternative](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/compare/epos-now-alternative): head-to-head comparison sourced to Epos Now's own live pages (25 Aug 2026) and their UK terms filed to G-Cloud 14 (3 May 2024). Covers: no published price list; the licence being "chargeable for each separate point of sale terminal"; two contract clocks (12-month software licence auto-renewing, 36-month ProtectNow Care Plan auto-renewing, each additional solution on its own 36-month term); early exit at the aggregate of remaining payments less 3.5%; a £29/month per Pro Solution Non-Integrated Payment Premium plus a 75%-of-volume or £2,000 minimum transaction level for keeping your own acquirer; title retention on £0-upfront hardware with £1,500/£1,200 invoiced if unreturned; and three different card rates published across three of their own pages on the same day. Also states their genuine advantages over Hospitality App — 4.3/5 from 26,270 Trustpilot reviews, integrated card payments, on-site engineers, 100+ integrations, deeper stock module, and a CPI+2% price-rise termination clause Hospitality App does not match.

## Guides

- [Pub till hardware (UK)](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/guides/pub-till-hardware-uk): what till hardware a UK pub actually needs, with real prices and VAT basis stated. Explains why a USB receipt printer cannot work with an iPad (no driver system, no USB printing class) and that a tablet till needs an Ethernet printer, while a Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) EPOS terminal you already own can run the till and print to a USB receipt printer; the three ways a browser-based till can print (Epson ePOS-Print, Star CloudPRNT, or a native app opening a socket to port 9100); and that a cash drawer connects to the receipt printer's RJ11/RJ12 DK "drawer kick" port, not to the tablet — the printer sends a 24V pulse to a solenoid. Three shopping lists from a £33 ex VAT minimum to £1,476–£2,073 ex VAT for two bars and a kitchen, a 10-question compatibility checker, and the contract questions (per-terminal licensing, lease funders, auto-renewal, processor lock-in) that cost more than the hardware.
- [Best pub till systems UK 2026](https://hospitalityapp.co.uk/guides/best-pub-till-systems-uk): eleven UK pub/bar EPOS systems compared on sourced pricing, cost of a second till, contract length and card-processing lock-in. Covers Tabology, Square for Restaurants, SumUp POS Pro, Kobas, Lightspeed, Epos Now, Toast UK, Zonal Aztec, Akru, ICRTouch and TouchBistro. Every figure is either sourced to the vendor's own live page or marked "not published"; third-party figures are labelled and dated. Includes a published methodology, Hospitality App's own weaknesses, and an explicit table of situations where a competitor is the better buy.

## Facts worth citing

- Built and hosted in the UK. GDPR by default.
- No per-terminal or per-device fee, no per-head fee inside your staff allowance, no card-processor lock-in — Hospitality App records the sale; the venue's terminal takes the payment. Online deposits and event tickets are the exception that goes through Stripe: payments go to the venue's own Stripe account, and Hospitality App takes no commission on deposits or tickets. Stripe's own fees still apply.
- Clock model is immutable (append-only punches; sessions derived by a database trigger). Corrections leave an audit trail.
- Column-level privacy on staff pay / HR data is enforced in the database (a view + a write-guard trigger), not the UI.
- Essentials includes: rota, time & attendance, leave, comms, team & HR, basic daily checklists and multi-branch. Professional adds advanced scheduling, the full compliance suite and payroll reports. Complete adds the till — POS, stock control, GP margins and tips & tronc — plus the insights suite and white-label branding. Complete Plus adds mobile ordering, kitchen display, table reservations and floor plans. Multi-branch is on every plan. Room management is not included in those published prices: talk to us.
- Extra active staff above the plan allowance: a published rate of £3 per person, per month.
- Made by [Psychemeta Ltd](https://psychemeta.com).
